title: Monitoring-Ready Files and Procedures
description: What monitors look for and how to be ready every day, not just the week before a visit. Covers WSD24-11 local monitoring standards, EO monitoring, file checklists, written procedures as evidence, and corrective action plans.
notes: Audience: Supervisors, quality assurance staff, subrecipient managers. Format: HD. Hours assumed from format (HD = 4 hours).
learning_objectives: Describe what local, state, and EO monitors review in participant files and procedures.
Build a file checklist and a sampling routine for internal quality review.
Show evidence that local policies were communicated to and implemented by staff.
Write a corrective action plan that closes a finding.

sequencing_rationale: Lessons follow the catalog's learning objectives in the order a practitioner meets them on the job: What Local, State, and EO Monitors Review; File Checklists and Internal Sampling; Evidence That Policies Reached Staff; Writing a Corrective Action Plan That Closes a Finding. The closing project ("Project: Mock Monitoring Review") applies the earlier lessons to one realistic work product (a mock monitoring review with a file checklist, internal sample results, policy-communication evidence, and a corrective action plan) rather than introducing new content. Scope assumptions: hours are not stated in the source catalog and are assumed from the delivery format (HD; HD = 4 hours). Content is grounded in California and federal guidance named in the catalog description and objectives; the course cites those directives by number but does not reproduce their text, and every policy-specific claim must be checked against the current directive before delivery. Local board policy is treated as a variable the learner fills in from their own board, not something the course prescribes. Prerequisites reflect track order: CMP 201 (Data Element Validation Readiness) recommended.
